This Data Processing Addendum (“DPA”) forms part of the Eloquent AI

(the “Agreement”) between Eloquent AI, Inc. (“Eloquent AI,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) and the customer identified in the Agreement (“Customer”). This DPA governs the processing of personal data by Eloquent AI on behalf of the Customer and sets out the parties’ obligations under applicable data protection laws
In the event of any conflict between this DPA and the Agreement, the provisions of this DPA shall prevail
to comply with Applicable Data Protection Laws; otherwise, the Agreement shall govern.
Applicable Data Protection Laws

: Refers to all laws and regulations applicable to the processing of personal data under this DPA, including but not limited to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK GDPR, UK Data Protection Act 2018, Swiss Federal Data Protection Act, California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and any amendments or successors to these laws.
: The entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.
: The entity that processes personal data on behalf of the Controller.
: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, as defined under applicable data protection laws.
: Any third-party service provider engaged by Eloquent AI to process Personal Data on behalf of the Customer.
: The Customer acts as the Controller and ensures compliance with all applicable data protection laws, including obtaining necessary consents and providing notices to data subjects.
Eloquent AI as Processor
: Eloquent AI acts as the Processor and will process Personal Data only on the Customer’s documented instructions unless required by law.

Where Eloquent AI is legally required to process Personal Data other than on Customer’s documented instructions, it will inform Customer of that requirement before processing, unless the relevant law prohibits such notice on important grounds of public interest. Any such processing remains subject to Applicable Data Protection Laws and mandatory international-transfer requirements.
Each party will cooperate in good faith as reasonably necessary to meet its respective legal obligations under Applicable Data Protection Laws.

Eloquent AI acts as an independent Controller for its own account management, billing and website analytics activities described in the Privacy Policy. This does not convert Personal Data processed on Customer’s behalf, including masked or pseudonymised data, into independent-controller data or authorise its use for general platform improvements outside Section 3.3.
3. Scope of Processing
: The processing of Personal Data is required to deliver the services specified in the Agreement.

: Personal Data will be processed for the term of the Agreement and, after termination, only for the limited purposes and periods specified in Section 8, subject to Customer's documented instructions and Applicable Data Protection Laws.
